title: The nuclear receptor LRH-1 discriminates between ligands using distinct allosteric signaling circuits.
authors: Mays, Suzanne G; Hercules, David; Ortlund, Eric A; Okafor, C Denise
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究核受体LRH-1（转录因子）配体诱导的别构信号通路，聚焦配体与共调节因子结合界面的动态通讯机制，虽非直接TF-DNA结合，但属于转录因子构象动态与互作机制建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Nuclear receptors (NRs) are transcription factors that regulate essential biological processes in response to cognate ligands. An important part of NR function involves ligand-induced conformational changes that recruit coregulator proteins to the activation function surface (AFS), ~15 A away from the ligand-binding pocket. Ligands must communicate with the AFS to recruit appropriate coregulators and elicit different transcriptional outcomes, but this communication is poorly understood. These studies illuminate allosteric communication networks underlying activation of liver receptor homolog-1 (LRH-1), a NR that regulates development, metabolism, cancer progression, and intestinal inflammation. Using >100 mus of all-atom molecular dynamics simulations involving 74 LRH-1 complexes, we identify distinct signaling circuits used by active and inactive ligands for AFS communication. Inactive ligands communicate via strong, coordinated motions along paths through the receptor to the AFS. Activating ligands disrupt the "inactive" circuit and induce connectivity with a second allosteric site. Ligand-contacting residues in helix 7 help mediate the switch between circuits, suggesting new avenues for developing LRH-1-targeted therapeutics. We also elucidate aspects of coregulator signaling, showing that localized, destabilizing fluctuations are induced by inappropriate ligand-coregulator pairings. These studies have uncovered novel features of LRH-1 allostery, and the quantitative approach used to analyze many simulations provides a framework to study allosteric signaling in other receptors.
abstract_zh: 核受体（Nuclear receptors, NRs）是一类转录因子，响应同源配体调控关键生物过程。NR功能的重要部分涉及配体诱导的构象变化，这些变化将共调节蛋白招募至激活功能表面（activation function surface, AFS），该表面距离配体结合口袋约15 Å。配体必须与AFS通信以招募适当的共调节蛋白并引发不同的转录结果，但这种通信机制尚不明确。本研究阐明了肝受体同源物-1（liver receptor homolog-1, LRH-1）激活背后的变构通信网络，LRH-1是一种调控发育、代谢、癌症进展和肠道炎症的核受体。通过涉及74个LRH-1复合物的超过100微秒全原子分子动力学模拟，我们识别出活性和非活性配体用于AFS通信的不同信号回路。非活性配体通过沿受体至AFS路径的强协调运动进行通信。激活配体则破坏“非活性”回路，并诱导与第二个变构位点的连接。螺旋7中接触配体的残基有助于介导回路间的切换，为开发靶向LRH-1的治疗药物提供了新途径。我们还阐明了共调节蛋白信号传导的某些方面，表明不适当的配体-共调节蛋白配对会引发局部去稳定化波动。这些研究揭示了LRH-1变构的新特征，用于分析大量模拟的定量方法为研究其他受体中的变构信号传导提供了框架。
